title: CROSSING
description: DAEMON//STUDIO 001 demonstration. Three approved instrument families transform in opposite directions and cross at bar 11.

sections.development: alien machinery and the impossible voice: gong bars, laser springs, a bowed drone with a twelfth-below subharmonic, bearings, zipping clock; the theme as a fragment
the Living Bass enters warm with a West Coast groove; tines and clock wake; the voice sings the whole theme, still strange
voice and orchestra fall toward human and clockwork while the bass rises toward the machine; at bar 11 every macro is near 0.5 and voice and bars sing the theme in unison
roles exchanged: a human voice and a clockwork music box over a growling machine bass with triplet and thirty-second gear motion
the machine bass relaxes back to warm inside one held low C; the human hum ends on C and the glass halo returns as an echo
